key_points: October results showed net premiums written of $7.1B and a 91.2% combined ratio, but net income fell and earned premium growth slowed to 1%.
The soft monthly growth/earnings update likely drove the 3.58% share decline and reinforces near-term deceleration concerns.
Jefferies maintained Hold after mixed Q3 results, suggesting limited upside conviction among sell-side analysts.
Snapshot Pro fleet telematics rollout is a modest positive product development but not yet thesis-changing.
Dividend commentary and generic fund/price-target notes are mostly noise; Morgan Stanley’s $235 target provides only a reference point.
